name: Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, September 20, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
Employee Recognition Awards
B.
Sheriff's Quarterly Report Update
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on September 6, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2016-41 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
July 2016 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
Award a Professional Services Agreement with MuniEnvironmental, LLC to prepare an audit of CalMet's billing and performance for calendar year 2015.
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to sign a professional services agreement with MuniEnvironmental, LLC to prepare an audit of CalMet's billing and performance for calendar year 2015.
Item #7i
j.
Easement located within the Cypress Water Production facility property for electrical distribution purposes
Res. 2016-42 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita authorizing the City Manager to execute a grant of easement to Southern California Edison for electrical purposes.
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt a resolution approving the easement as requested by Southern California Edison.
Item #7j
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONFIRMATION OF A LIEN FOR THE COLLECTION OF NUISANCE ABATEMENT COSTS FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 26011 CAYUGA AVENUE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res. 2016-43 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita ordering the recordation of an abatement lien against the title of the property located at 26011 Cayuga Avenue, Lomita (APN 7553-016-001) in the amount of $7,372.25, and permitting the collection of interest in the amount of seven percent per year.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted confirming the placement of a lien against the title of the property located at 26011 Cayuga Avenue in the amount of $7,372.25 and permitting the collection of interest of seven percent per year.
Item #8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
Commission/Board appointments for two vacancies and two expired terms: (1) Planning Commission and (1) Parks & Recreation Commission and two expired terms: (1) Planning Commission and (1) Public Safety and Traffic Commission.
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council make appointments to the Planning Commission and Parks & Recreation Commission and appointments for two expired terms one the Planning Commission and one on the Public Safety and Traffic Commission.
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, October 4, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
